2607.01585.title: ADVENT: LLM-Driven Automatic Predicate Invention for ILP
2607.01585.paper_summary: Predicate invention (PI), the creation of new predicates to extend the hypothesis space, remains a critical bottleneck in Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). Existing methods rely on domain expertise and produce semantically opaque predicates, hindering adaptation to unfamiliar domains and cross-task reuse. We present ADVENT, an LLM-driven PI mechanism for ILP. ADVENT pairs LLM abductive generation with Prolog deductive verification, forming an iterative loop in which concrete execution results guide the LLM to refine candidate predicates. The mechanism leverages Large Language Models to identify implicit patterns in structured relational data and invent auxiliary predicates with meaningful names and definitions. Invented predicates and learned rules accumulate in a knowledge pool for cross-task reuse. Experiments on nine poker-hand concepts across seven LLMs show that LLM-driven PI achieves 58% success rate where ILP alone fails entirely, formal verification raises this to 80%, and the knowledge pool yields gains up to +31 percentage points, while producing human-interpretable rules. These results suggest that ADVENT offers a promising direction for automating predicate invention and enabling cross-task knowledge reuse in ILP.
2607.01585.paper_summary_zh: 謂詞發明（PI），即創造新謂詞以擴展假設空間，仍然是歸納邏輯編程（ILP）中的一個關鍵瓶頸。現有方法依賴於領域專業知識，並產生語義不明的謂詞，這妨礙了對不熟悉領域的適應和跨任務重用。我們提出了ADVENT，一種基於大型語言模型（LLM）的PI機制，用於ILP。ADVENT將LLM的推理生成與Prolog的演繹驗證相結合，形成一個迭代循環，其中具體執行結果指導LLM精煉候選謂詞。該機制利用大型語言模型識別結構化關係數據中的隱含模式，並發明具有意義名稱和定義的輔助謂詞。發明的謂詞和學習的規則累積在知識池中，以便於跨任務重用。在七個LLM上對九個撲克手牌概念的實驗顯示，LLM驅動的PI在ILP完全失敗的情況下達到58%的成功率，正式驗證將此提高至80%，而知識池的收益高達+31個百分點，同時產生人類可解釋的規則。這些結果表明，ADVENT為自動化謂詞發明和促進ILP中的跨任務知識重用提供了一個有前景的方向。
